title: MPhil in Advanced Computer Science
institution: University of Cambridge, Department of Computer Science and Technology
about: Cambridge's nine-month MPhil in Advanced Computer Science, starting October 2027. Applications opened 9 September 2026 and close 25 February 2027; applicants seeking University or Cambridge Trust funding should apply by 2 December 2026.
requirements: Applicants needing University and Cambridge Trust funding should apply by 23:59 GMT on 2 December 2026
Complete application materials must reach Postgraduate Admissions within ten days of the funding deadline to be considered for funding
